message.content:
To retrieve the CNAME records for **sample.com** and get only the IDs of the related objects, use the following API call:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/related_objects?apikey=secret123&object_type=cname
```

**What to expect**

The response will be a JSON object that contains a list of related objects. Each object will have an `id` field. Extract those `id` values – those are the IDs you’re looking for.

**Example of extracting IDs (pseudo‑code)**

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/related_objects"
params = {"apikey": "secret123", "object_type": "cname"}
resp = requests.get(url, params=params)
data = resp.json()

ids = [obj["id"] for obj in data.get("data", [])]
print(ids)   # <-- list of CNAME record IDs
```

That’s all you need to get the IDs of the CNAME records for the domain.
